# Microsoft Foundry — AI Agent Lifecycle

💳 Paid Azure subscription required — Curated by Skill Harbor — the official Microsoft playbook for the full Microsoft Foundry lifecycle: scaffold and deploy hosted or prompt agents, invoke and chat with them, run batch and continuous evaluations, optimize prompts from trace data, fine-tune models (SFT distillation, DPO, RFT with graders), and manage the surrounding platform (quotas, capacity per region, RBAC role assignments, private-network isolation).
